run_extract_file: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
run_process_func: process VASP relaxation trajectories in parallel to extract final potential energy values
run_get_energies_main: run the script to extract final energies from VASP vasprun.xml files across multiple directories
refactor_process_func: refactor process_func to support additional trajectory formats beyond vasp-xml
review_extract_file: review extract_file to add error handling for missing or corrupt zip files
